en: I am a hairdresser by trade.
Are you wondering why a mere hairdresser
lives in a house like this?
The ladies of this city have been kind
enough to favour me, so I have a bit
put aside, you see.
Do come visit my beauty salon.
Please do visit the salon again, too.
After work, I make a point of resting
quietly at home.
The mornings are busy, you see.
How good of you to come.
I'll have tea prepared right away.
You even have servants.
Well, yes.
Thanks to my salon clients, I can now
afford a life of luxury.
With all my heart,
I shall see to your every need.
Good day, and welcome to the beauty salon.
I am Arthur, the hairdresser.
I am glad to say the salon is popular
with a great many noble ladies.
Of course,
clients other than ladies are welcome too.
If it interests you,
please do come again.
Welcome to the beauty salon.
Arthur the hairdresser, at your service.
My main work is dressing noble ladies' hair.
Curls hanging down at the sides of the face
are all the fashion now.
A noble princess famed throughout London,
Lady Rose of the Epstein family, wears her
hair this way too.
And you,
are a handsome man indeed...
The noble ladies who come here
talk of nothing but you.
Looking fine is not just for women,
you know,
All the more so for a handsome gentleman
such as yourself, sir.
One can never take too much care
over one's appearance.
How about having your hair curled,
I apply this curling iron to the hair
and twirl it into ringlets.
No, I think I shall decline.
We also have wigs for gentlemen.
Long hair tied back at the nape, say
I am fond of my hair as it is.
Do come by if you ever change your mind.
Then for today, allow me to give you
a beauty mask, perhaps.
I'm just about to set a lady's hair,
so please wait a moment.
There, madam, thank you for waiting.
Curls piled up high, set with pomade,
a dusting of hair powder, silk flowers
Lastly, a touch of perfume.
There, all done.
Madam, you look simply lovely.
When you go to bed, do wear
a nightcap.
How was the beauty mask the other day?
Well, it wasn't bad.
Then the same again today.
Today, too, I have prepared
a special facial treatment for you.
Lately, the noble ladies have all been
stolen from me by my client
Every last one of them...
Damn it. When I'm the one
who's the better-looking man...
Wh-why are
you here?
